briefdescription.para: Get the state recorded for the given symbol.
Emit a label for Symbol into the current section.

detaileddescription.para: This corresponds to an assembler statement such as: foo:

parameterdescription.para: - The symbol to emit. A given symbol should only be emitted as a label once, and symbols emitted as a label should never be used in an assignment.

briefdescription.para: Emit an assignment of Value to Symbol.

detaileddescription.para: This corresponds to an assembler statement such as: symbol = value
The assignment generates no code, but has the side effect of binding the value in the current context. For the assembly streamer, this prints the binding into the .s file.
